assessment.message: AppCAT assessment for Java projects requires MCP tools 'appmod-precheck-assessment' and 'appmod-run-assessment' to be configured.

setupInstructions.description: To run AppCAT assessment for this Java project, configure the following MCP tools in your environment:

tools.name: appmod-precheck-assessment
tools.purpose: Checks prerequisites and prepares the environment for AppCAT analysis

tools.name: appmod-run-assessment
tools.purpose: Executes AppCAT analysis and generates the assessment report

steps: 1. Configure 'appmod-precheck-assessment' MCP tool in your MCP server settings
2. Configure 'appmod-run-assessment' MCP tool in your MCP server settings
3. Re-run the assessment skill once the MCP tools are available
4. The assessment report will be generated at .github/modernize/appcat/report.json
